content.comment_body: I'm looking for advice on how the [product_name] Communication Interface Module (CIM) can receive data from a reader that sends raw data, not Modbus RTU. I previously succeeded using a USB to RS485 adapter, but now I need to process that data with a [product_name] PLC. Is there any way to do this, or is the [product_name] CIM only capable of RS485 communication based on specific protocols?

Hello, The CIM provides an RS485 interface, but it is limited to Modbus RTU communication only. Other types of data transmission are not possible through this interface. If your device does not support Modbus RTU, it will not be compatible with the CIM. Hope this clarifies things.
Are there alternatives that could work with different hardware? For example, could a [product_name] controller with a different communication module allow processing of raw RS485 data?

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to process raw RS485 data from a third-party reader using a [company_name] communication module, but faces limitations because the module supports only Modbus RTU protocol. Responses confirm this protocol restriction, highlighting that raw data or non-Modbus protocols cannot be handled. The discussion identifies a need for [company_name] hardware to offer broader RS485 data handling capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [company_name] communication modules to support processing of raw RS485 data or to be compatible with devices that do not use Modbus RTU. They seek more flexible integration options for device communication.
